feed.title: NPR Topics: News
feed.subtitle: NPR news, audio, and podcasts. Coverage of breaking stories, national and world news, politics, business, science, technology, and extended coverage of major national and world events.

entry.title: Wisconsin congressman survives emergency plane landing, swims to safety
entry.summary: Wisconsin Congressman Tom Tiffany escaped a sinking plane and swam to shallow water after an emergency landing in a lake. Tiffany and the pilot called 911 from on top of the plane.

entry.title: Actor Tatyana Ali is advocating for Black and Indigenous maternal health
entry.summary: Actor Tatyana Ali says her healing journey after a traumatic childbirth has inspired her advocacy for Black maternal health, including support for midwives, doulas and other birth workers.

entry.title: Politics chat: Trump's $5,000 promise to voters, Vance invokes Charlie Kirk
entry.summary: Following the midterm convention in Dallas, President Trump's $5,000 campaign promise has generated attention, but not belief. And, Vice President JD Vance characterizes Democrats as extremists.

entry.title: Can you imagine a universe without a new 'Star Trek' on the horizon?
entry.summary: As Star Trek celebrates its 60th birthday, the long-running franchise is also grappling with the challenges of timing and technology. "Its audience is aging," says Strange New Worlds star Anson Mount.

entry.title: Indonesian passenger ship overturns, sparking search for at least 129 missing
entry.summary: Indonesian rescuers said about 130 passengers and crew are missing after a ferry carrying more than 240 people sank in bad weather in the Java Sea on Sunday.

entry.title: How a young woman was recruited to ISIS — and how she eventually escaped
entry.summary: A young Canadian mother shares her memories of being an ISIS bride, and her harrowing escape from the extremist group.

entry.title: Celine Dion returns to the stage after battling rare illness
entry.summary: The Canadian singer opened up her 16-show residency in Paris at the Plenitude Arena. The entire series is sold out.

entry.title: Alien Terrorist Removal Court deports legal US resident to Afghanistan in first-ever case
entry.summary: Nazira Haji Zada, a lawful permanent resident, conceded to being an "alien terrorist." It marks the first case in the Alien Terrorist Removal Court.

entry.title: 'People are still afraid of those three letters': Fighting the stigma of HIV
entry.summary: That's a quote from former rugby star Gareth Thomas, who is HIV positive. At the International AIDS Conference in Rio this year, he spoke out about the isolation and discrimination tied to the virus.

entry.title: OPINION: 25 years on, a nation still mourns
entry.summary: A moment to remember those lost in the 9/11 terrorist attacks 25 years ago yesterday.
